name: iVR-GS Relighting via Gaussian Primitives
definition: Models lighting effects using the Blinn-Phong model to enable relighting by adjusting the light source polar angle while keeping the azimuthal angle aligned with the camera.
summary: iVR-GS is a novel view synthesis framework that enables high-quality relighting of volume scenes by modeling lighting effects via the Blinn-Phong model on 3D Gaussian primitives.
